R1.title: Joseon annals / National Archives chronology
R1.publisher: National Institute of Korean History; National Archives of Korea
R1.supports: Joseon 1392; dynasty and empire lasted over five centuries.

R2.title: 대한제국의 성립과 광무개혁
R2.supports: 1897 empire; Gojong reforms and diplomacy; Russo-Japanese War and 1905 loss of diplomatic rights.

R3.title: 순종실록 해제; 한일병합
R3.supports: 1910 annexation ended the independent imperial state; Sunjong reduced to Yi Wang. Members of the family survived.

R4.title: 정미칠조약 and forced abdication
R4.supports: Hague envoys, forced abdication in 1907, Resident-General intervention in laws and appointments.

R5.title: 이은 (李垠)
R5.supports: 1907 child hostage; Japanese education and military career; 1920 political marriage; succession to family rank in 1926; delayed return; ill at return under Park in 1963.

R6.title: FRUS 1945: Korea occupation and trusteeship discussions
R6.publisher: US Department of State, Office of the Historian
R6.supports: Actual US/Soviet occupation; four-power trusteeship proposal including UK and China was distinct from occupation zones.

R7.title: Korean conflict, armistice, Korea Divided
R7.publisher: US National Archives; US Army Center of Military History
R7.supports: 1945 division, 1948 states, Soviet backing of Kim, 1950 war and 1953 armistice.

R8.title: 대한민국 임시헌장 (1919)
R8.publisher: Korean National Law Information Center; NIKH
R8.supports: Article 1 declared a democratic republic before liberation.

R9.title: 대한민국헌법: 1948 founding constitution
R9.supports: Articles 1 and 2: democratic republic and sovereignty vested in the people. Screen shows a marked summary, not a facsimile.

R10.title: 복벽주의; 대동단
R10.publisher: NIKH; Academy of Korean Studies; National Archives of Korea
R10.supports: Restoration ideas existed; Yi Gang attempted escape with Daedongdan in 1919. Royal family should not be treated uniformly.

R11.title: 1948.7.20: election of the first president
R11.publisher: National Election Commission Election Museum; US Department of State; AKS
R11.supports: Rhee anti-communist politics; constituent National Assembly elected president 20 July 1948, not a direct American presidential appointment.

R12.title: Treaty of Shimonoseki, Article 1
R12.publisher: US Department of State; Japan Center for Asian Historical Records
R12.supports: Japan won Sino-Japanese War; Qing recognized Korean independence and relinquished tributary claims.

R13.title: 1963년 11월 22일 영친왕 귀국
R13.supports: Yi Un returned from Japan in 1963; not a restoration of monarchy.
